Metal-covered imperial capital.

How Trantor connects

  • Faction: Second Foundation — The Second Foundation hides at Star's End near Trantor.
  • Character: Hari Seldon — Seldon's trial and court years happen on Trantor.

What is Trantor?

Trantor is the city-planet capital of Empire, a world under metal where Seldon stands trial and where later stories hunt Star's End.

Key threads lead to Galactic Empire, Second Foundation and Hari Seldon.
